title: Make every path agree on which car a plate is

cases.says: with plates written the same way everywhere, permits are registered, seen by the camera and transferred, and a car never holds two
the camera's check recognises a car whose permit was bought with the plate written another way
a transfer is refused when the target car already holds a permit under another spelling of its plate
a permit transferred from a plate written with spaces leaves that car without a permit
a plate typed in lower case with an i matches the camera's reading under a Turkish default locale

origin.section: One Method Decides When Two Names Are the Same, and Every Path Calls It
